meta.title: dsh-remote-explorer
meta.description: Remote development launcher: install dsh on a remote host and use it from your local browser. LLM credentials never leave your machine.

en.countdown: Session ready — entering remote window in
en.envDialogApplyHint: Takes effect on the next connection; running sessions must be disconnected (with "Also stop remote dsh" checked) and reconnected to pick it up
en.envDialogDomainHint: Settings are stored per transport form (SSH / WSL) and never affect each other; this dialog edits the configuration of the form it was opened from
en.envDialogHint: Saved globally (remembers your last input, shared across hosts) in the host-side ~/.dsh/remote-advanced.json only; injected into the remote dsh process when connecting
en.envInvalidKey: Invalid variable name (letters/digits/underscore only, must not start with a digit):
en.envReservedKey: Reserved key (managed by the tool itself):
en.envSkipHint: Rows without a variable name are skipped on save
en.external: External (kept by another local process, read-only; manage it there or via the CLI)
en.hostDisconnectExternal: The sessions of this host are maintained by other local processes; disconnect from that process or the CLI
en.hostPickerNoMatch: No matching host (you can also type user@host[:port])
en.intentDisconnect: The remote window asked to close this remote connection (local tunnel and session registration go away; remote dsh stays)
en.intentStop: The remote window asked to stop the remote dsh and close this remote connection
en.jumpConfigHint: This host is defined in ssh config — its jump hosts come from the config ProxyJump and are read-only here. Edit ~/.ssh/config to change them
en.jumpDirectHint: Direct hosts (user@host[:port]) can configure a jump chain: one ssh config alias or user@host[:port] per row, connected in list order. Saved globally (remembers your last input; applies to direct hosts only)
en.jumpPasswordHint: Passwords are never written to disk: they travel in memory with the connect request and must be re-entered each time; lower priority than the private key
en.jumpUnknownHost: Select or type a host above first
en.logEmpty: Select a session row to view its progress log
en.missingKeys: LLM key env vars missing on this machine
en.overlayReturnHint: Press Esc to return to the manager
en.passwordWarning: The password stays in the host dsh process memory only — never written to disk or logged; leave empty to require an IdentityFile on the host
en.proxyDialogApplyHint: Expanded into eight proxy env vars (http_proxy/https_proxy/no_proxy …) at connect time; running sessions must be reconnected to pick it up
en.proxyDialogHint: Outbound HTTP(S) proxy for the remote dsh (e.g. installing GitHub plugins); saved globally, shared across hosts. Save empty to clear
en.proxyPlaceholder: http://127.0.0.1:18890 (remote end of the SSH reverse tunnel)
en.sectionIntro: Manage SSH and WSL remote sessions: installs dsh on a remote environment and serves its UI to this browser; LLM credentials never leave this machine.
en.sshSectionIntro: Connect to a remote host via SSH and run dsh there; sessions live in this dsh process — quitting dsh disconnects or keeps the remote per config.
en.wslNotInstalledHint: Please install WSL and add a Linux distribution. Run in PowerShell (Admin): wsl --install -d Ubuntu, then restart the app.
en.wslNotInstalledTitle: WSL not installed or no distributions available
en.wslSectionIntro: Connect to a local WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux) distribution and run dsh inside it; no SSH configuration needed.
